item.title: Draft Cabinet Order on Priority Industrial Technologies and Economic Security
item.description: AI summary: The draft Cabinet Order would designate priority industrial technologies in six fields: artificial intelligence and advanced robotics; quantum technology; semiconductors and communications; biotechnology and healthcare; fusion energy; and space activities. It would amend the Enforcement Order of the Industrial Technology Enhancement Act by adding this designation and specifying the responsible ministers for listed industrial technology research corporations, while updating statutory cross-references. It would also amend the Economic Security Promotion Act Enforcement Order's provision concerning inventions referred to the Prime Minister, including references governing patent rights retained for government-commissioned research and software development. The Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry published the draft and related proposed rules, guidelines and examination criteria for public comment on 2026-11-09; the stated deadline was 2026-12-08 23:59 JST. The listed contacts are the Research and Development Division and University Collaboration Promotion Office of the ministry's Innovation and Environment Bureau. Original title: 産業技術力強化法施行令及び経済施策を一体的に講ずることによる安全保障の確保の推進に関する法律施行令の一部を改正する政令案等に対する意見募集について Public Comment Open | e-Gov Public Comment | Published 2026-11-09 | First detected 2026-11-10 Monitoring aid only; not legal advice or an official translation.
